turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We currently do not ship worldwide. Our shipping regions are:

Contiguous United States: all products
Alaska & Hawaii: select products
Canada: select items to limited regions

Outside the US and those eligible parts of Canada, we do not ship internationally.

For orders going to Canada:

All required fees, taxes, duties, and certifications are already included in the prices and shipping charges you see at checkout.
You will not need to pay extra customs or obtain any special paperwork yourself; we handle the necessary certifications on our side.

If you tell me what country you’re in, I can confirm whether shipping is possible to a US or Canadian address you might have access to.

How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping timing has two parts:

Preparation & scheduling
At checkout, you’ll choose an estimated arrival date from our delivery calendar (for US orders) or a ship week (for eligible Canadian orders).
The dates shown already factor in our processing time plus typical carrier transit time to your address.
Transit time
For most locations, transit is typically about 1–5 business days once your order leaves our nursery, depending on how far you are from Oregon.
All delivery dates are estimates, since weather and carrier delays can occasionally affect timing.

Our packaging is designed so roses and other plants travel safely during that window. If you share your state or province, I can give you a more tailored expectation for your area.
